newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shrs seen rising on foreigner ceiling boost.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shrs seen rising on foreigner ceiling boost.

text.p: Shares are expected to gain momentum on Wednesday ahead of next week's foreign shareholdings limit expansion, brokers said.
The composite index closed Tuesday up 8.71 points to 777.91 on active volume.

"I believe the market will continue to be bullish today in anticipation of the expansion," said an LG Securities broker. He saw KEPCO, Samsung Electronics and other blue chips being supported, while individual small-cap shares would rise sharply.
Foreigners will be able to buy up to 20 percent of most stocks from October 1, up from the current 18 percent.
The market will be closed from September 26-28 for Chusok, the Korean Thanksgiving holiday.
